scene: The glowing tunnel opens into a bustling transit cavern. How will you travel?
picture: Along a flat stone platform, a turquoise ferry floats at a dock on the far left. The player in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands centre facing forward. Overhead, a glass cable car hangs up high, and a red street tram waits on tracks on the far right.
shown: a turquoise passenger ferry bobbing at the wooden dock on the far left
a glass cable car hanging open on an overhead wire up high
a bright red street tram resting on steel tracks on the far right
